g.text: 7. ND state mover and the PMPS pieces under every device
BP_jsonDoc is one shared document guarded only by a BOOL, and
FB_HardwareFFOutput is not safe across tasks. A project runs
PMPS from one task. kfe runs it on core 2, not core 0 where the
EXTENDS only because it is a drop-in state mover plus one
composed PMPS member. Everything else is injected, not extended.
